messages.subject: Checkpoint-configured evaluation geometry verified
messages.body: Implemented checkpoint-configured native evaluation geometry: configured spacing resamples before model inference, physical XY FOV fixes model windows with invalid edge padding, and reversible transforms invert probabilities/support to native before argmax; native_z behavior remains unchanged and image-only mode remains mask-free. Independent verification passed with a nonidentity spacing/FOV witness, checkpoint-CLI config propagation witness, 13 evaluation tests, 31 combined owned/compatibility tests, py_compile, and check_repo PASS. Remaining evidence is bounded CPU/manufactured software only; no patient masks, GPU, pretrained downloads, network, or long training were used.

messages.subject: R2, LRU resume, and temporal observability repairs complete
messages.body: Resolved the R2 region boundary pooling defect via confident class boundary splitting, enforced detached EMA source requirements, restored LRU max_cache_size across state resume, and added pre-apodization variance rejection for unobservable temporal motion. All 13 Astra independent adversarial checks in review_geometry_aux.md pass (including the region_boundary witness with loss dropping from 0.499 to 7.5e-7), and all 34 owned unit tests in test_volume_regions.py and test_volume_temporal.py pass. All assigned blockers are cleared with source-ready hashes delivered to Astra and root, leaving zero remaining tasks in this lane.
